measures.label: Pitch
measures.hint: How high or low your voice is.

measures.label: Pitch variation
measures.hint: How much your pitch moves as you speak.

measures.label: Pitch steadiness
measures.hint: Tiny wobble in pitch from one cycle to the next. Lower is steadier.

measures.label: Loudness steadiness
measures.hint: Tiny wobble in loudness from one cycle to the next. Lower is steadier.

measures.label: Voice clarity
measures.hint: How clear the voice is against breath and noise. Higher is clearer.

measures.label: Pausing
measures.hint: Share of the reading spent silent.

measures.label: Speaking rate
measures.hint: How much voiced sound per second. Higher is faster.
